kept.title: Sharding - Sigstore
kept.snippet: This document covers what Rekor log sharding is and how to shard the log. What is sharding? # When Rekor is started for the first time, its backend is a transparency log built on a single Merkle Tree. This log can grow indefinitely as entries are added, which can present issues over time. To resolve some of these issues the log can be "sharded" into multiple Merkle Trees. Why do we shard ...
